name: Sketchbook
detailed_description:
Sometimes I try to remember the old house. My sister’s face. How we used to play, how I nursed her when she was sick…

But my mind always drags me back — to that day.

The day the fire took everything.

My childhood burned with that house. The memories… twisted. Fragments.

After we moved, my parents never spoke of it. As if silence could bury the truth.

But I know. It was no accident.

If your machine can really send me back… I’ll see it again.

The flames. The screams.

What really happened.

Help me, Professor.Step into the protagonist's shoes and journey through the haunting corridors of your childhood memories. Uncover the truth buried beneath the veil of forgotten past.

Core Gameplay Experience:

  • Battle enemies using magical weapon;

  • Solve puzzles that require unconventional thinking;

  • Explore an enchanted forest full of dangers

  • Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of childhood—with its fears, dreams, and mysteries;

  • Unravel the secrets of a morally ambiguous story through the lens of memories.

Game features:

  • Unique mechanics – gravity manipulation, time slowdown, and more;

  • Vibrant world – detailed environments with a touch of nostalgic charm;

  • Dramatic story – a deep narrative with complex characters and unexpected twists;

  • Genre-blending – a mix of horror, adventure, and fast-paced shooter elements in one piece;

  • Captivating soundtrack – music that enhances the atmosphere and emotions;

  • Awareness-based combat – victory goes to those who spot the threat before it materializes.
